show.description: A fallen prodigy rises from betrayal to reclaim his destiny in a world ruled by power and deception. Stripped of trust and left for dead, he returns stronger, sharper, and more dangerous than ever. As secrets unravel and loyalties shatter, every move becomes a battle for dominance. In this high-stakes game of ambition and revenge, will he conquer his fate or be consumed by it?
